description: This Java source file defines an enum class 'FuelAutoTune' implementing 'FuelAutoLogic' for auto-tuning fuel maps based on ECU data points. It includes methods for processing data, optimizing table cells, calculating deviations, and smoothing results, primarily used for fuel mixture calibration.

classes.name: FuelAutoTune
classes.description: Enum singleton class implementing fuel auto-tuning logic based on ECU data points.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main method to process ECU data points and optimize fuel map.

methods.name: getTotalDeviationAfterCellOptimization
methods.description: Optimizes a single cell in the fuel map to minimize deviation.

methods.name: countDeviation
methods.description: Calculates deviations of data points from target AFR over the fuel map.

methods.name: smooth
methods.description: Applies smoothing to the deviation map to reduce noise.
